# Workflows

Every pack runs the AI-DLC workflow: a decision-gated lifecycle whose base
instructions are shared by the packs. A workflow variant replaces named
slots of one base instruction for a specific situation. A pack selects the
variants it needs in its `pack.yaml`.

## Base workflow

| Instruction | Packs using the shared base |
|---|---|
| [aidlc-workflow.md](../common/instructions/aidlc-workflow.md) | [alpha-pack](../packs/alpha-pack/README.md) |
| [reverse-engineering.md](../common/instructions/reverse-engineering.md) | [alpha-pack](../packs/alpha-pack/README.md), [zeta-pack](../packs/zeta-pack/README.md) |

A pack not listed for an instruction ships its own copy in
`packs/<pack>/instructions/`.

## Variants

| Variant | Instruction | When to use | Packs |
|---|---|---|---|
| [New style](variants/new-style.md) (`new-style`) | aidlc-workflow.md | A variant in the new layout, selected through its old alias. | [alpha-pack](../packs/alpha-pack/README.md) |
| [shared-variant](../workflow-overlays/shared-variant.md) | reverse-engineering.md | Adds fixture evidence to reverse engineering. | [alpha-pack](../packs/alpha-pack/README.md) |
